keyPoints.en: Communism was founded on the ideas of Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels: a classless society where the state owns property.
keyPoints.bm: Komunisme berasaskan idea Karl Marx dan Friedrich Engels: masyarakat tanpa kelas dengan harta dimiliki negara.

keyPoints.en: Communist influence entered our country from China and from Indonesia in the 1920s.
keyPoints.bm: Pengaruh komunis masuk ke negara kita dari China dan dari Indonesia pada 1920-an.

keyPoints.en: The Communist Party of Malaya (PKM) was founded in 1930.
Its aim was to drive out the British and set up a communist republic of Malaya.
keyPoints.bm: Matlamatnya ialah mengusir British dan menubuhkan Republik Komunis Malaya.

meaning.en: Ideology aiming for a classless society, with the state owning all property and one party ruling.
meaning.bm: Ideologi yang bermatlamat masyarakat tanpa kelas, dengan negara memiliki semua harta dan satu parti memerintah.

meaning.en: Parti Komunis Malaya, founded 1930; led by Chin Peng from 1947.
meaning.bm: Parti Komunis Malaya, ditubuhkan 1930; dipimpin Chin Peng sejak 1947.

meaning.en: Civilian network that supplied the communists with food, money and information.
meaning.bm: Rangkaian orang awam yang membekalkan makanan, wang dan maklumat kepada komunis.

meaning.en: To secretly enter organisations to control them — e.g. trade unions.
meaning.bm: Masuk secara rahsia ke dalam pertubuhan untuk menguasainya — cth. kesatuan sekerja.

heading.bm: a. Kemasukan pengaruh komunis dari China

points.en: Agents from the Chinese Communist Party spread ideas among Chinese workers and schools in the 1920s.
points.bm: Ejen Parti Komunis China menyebarkan fahaman dalam kalangan pekerja dan sekolah Cina pada 1920-an.

heading.bm: b. Kemasukan pengaruh komunis dari Indonesia

points.en: Members of the Indonesian Communist Party (PKI), such as Alimin and Musso, tried to spread communism among the Malays after a failed revolt in Indonesia (1926).
points.bm: Ahli Parti Komunis Indonesia (PKI) seperti Alimin dan Musso cuba menyebarkan komunisme dalam kalangan orang Melayu selepas pemberontakan yang gagal di Indonesia (1926).

points.en: PKM was founded in 1930 and worked through trade unions and student groups.
points.bm: PKM ditubuhkan pada 1930 dan bergerak melalui kesatuan sekerja dan kumpulan pelajar.

points.en: After the war it was legal at first, controlled many unions and organised strikes (1946–1948).
points.bm: Selepas perang ia sah pada awalnya, menguasai banyak kesatuan dan menganjurkan mogok (1946–1948).

points.en: In 1948 it turned to armed struggle from the jungle.
points.bm: Pada 1948 ia beralih kepada perjuangan bersenjata dari hutan.

question.en: Why did the PKM gain support after World War II?
question.bm: Mengapakah PKM mendapat sokongan selepas Perang Dunia Kedua?

answer.en: Its MPAJA had fought the Japanese, so some saw it as heroes; it also exploited post-war hardship — low wages, food shortages — through trade unions.
answer.bm: MPAJA nya telah menentang Jepun, maka sesetengah orang menganggapnya wira; ia juga mengeksploitasi kesusahan selepas perang — gaji rendah, kekurangan makanan — melalui kesatuan sekerja.

keyPoints.en: On 16 June 1948 communists killed three European planters at Sungai Siput, Perak.
keyPoints.bm: Pada 16 Jun 1948 komunis membunuh tiga orang pengurus ladang Eropah di Sungai Siput, Perak.

keyPoints.en: The British declared a State of Emergency, first in Perak and Johor and then throughout the country; it lasted until 31 July 1960.
keyPoints.bm: British mengisytiharkan Darurat, mula-mula di Perak dan Johor dan kemudian di seluruh negara; ia berlarutan hingga 31 Julai 1960.

keyPoints.en: Communists tried to cripple the economy, destroy infrastructure and threaten the people and security forces.
keyPoints.bm: Komunis cuba melumpuhkan ekonomi, memusnahkan infrastruktur dan mengancam rakyat serta pasukan keselamatan.

keyPoints.en: The attack on Bukit Kepong police station (23 February 1950) is remembered for the police's bravery.
keyPoints.bm: Serangan ke atas balai polis Bukit Kepong (23 Februari 1950) dikenang kerana keberanian anggota polis.

meaning.en: Special government powers to deal with a serious threat to security.
meaning.bm: Kuasa khas kerajaan untuk menghadapi ancaman keselamatan yang serius.

meaning.en: Deliberately destroying property, e.g. slashing rubber trees or blowing up bridges.
meaning.bm: Memusnahkan harta dengan sengaja, cth. menetak pokok getah atau meletupkan jambatan.

meaning.en: Police station in Johor attacked by about 180 communists; most defenders and some family members were killed.
meaning.bm: Balai polis di Johor yang diserang kira-kira 180 komunis; kebanyakan anggota yang mempertahankannya dan sebahagian ahli keluarga terkorban.

points.en: After the Sungai Siput killings the British declared an Emergency and banned the PKM (July 1948).
points.bm: Selepas pembunuhan di Sungai Siput British mengisytiharkan Darurat dan mengharamkan PKM (Julai 1948).

points.en: It was called an "Emergency", not a war, so that insurance companies would still pay for losses of estates and mines.
points.bm: Ia dipanggil "Darurat", bukan perang, supaya syarikat insurans masih membayar kerugian ladang dan lombong.

points.en: Crippling the economy: slashing rubber trees, burning estates and attacking mines.
points.bm: Melumpuhkan ekonomi: menetak pokok getah, membakar ladang dan menyerang lombong.

points.en: Destroying infrastructure: bridges, railways, trains and telephone lines.
points.bm: Merosakkan infrastruktur: jambatan, landasan kereta api, kereta api dan talian telefon.

points.en: Threatening the people: killings, kidnapping and extortion.
points.bm: Mengancam keselamatan rakyat: pembunuhan, penculikan dan peras ugut.

points.en: Threatening the security forces: ambushes and attacks on police stations, e.g. Bukit Kepong (1950); High Commissioner Sir Henry Gurney was killed at Fraser's Hill (6 October 1951).
points.bm: Mengancam pasukan keselamatan: serangan hendap dan serangan ke atas balai polis, cth. Bukit Kepong (1950); Pesuruhjaya Tinggi Sir Henry Gurney dibunuh di Bukit Fraser (6 Oktober 1951).

event.en: Three planters killed at Sungai Siput; Emergency declared.
event.bm: Tiga pengurus ladang dibunuh di Sungai Siput; Darurat diisytiharkan.

event.en: Attack on Bukit Kepong police station.
event.bm: Serangan ke atas balai polis Bukit Kepong.

event.en: Sir Henry Gurney killed at Fraser's Hill.
event.bm: Sir Henry Gurney dibunuh di Bukit Fraser.

alt.bm: Pekerja getah ke tempat kerja dikawal Special Constables, sekitar 1950.

question.en: Why did the government call it an "Emergency" and not a "war"?

answer.en: Insurance would not cover losses caused by war; calling it an Emergency let estates and mines claim insurance and kept the economy running.
answer.bm: Insurans tidak melindungi kerugian akibat perang; dengan menamakannya Darurat, ladang dan lombong masih boleh menuntut insurans dan ekonomi terus berjalan.

keyPoints.en: The government fought the communists with laws, security forces and campaigns to win people's support.
keyPoints.bm: Kerajaan menentang komunis dengan undang-undang, pasukan keselamatan dan kempen memenangi sokongan rakyat.

keyPoints.en: The Briggs Plan (1950) moved squatters into New Villages to cut the communists' supplies.
keyPoints.bm: Rancangan Briggs (1950) memindahkan setinggan ke Kampung Baru untuk memutuskan bekalan komunis.

keyPoints.en: Sir Gerald Templer (1952–1954) used the "hearts and minds" approach.
keyPoints.bm: Sir Gerald Templer (1952–1954) menggunakan pendekatan "memenangi hati dan fikiran" rakyat.

keyPoints.en: The Baling Talks (28–29 December 1955) failed because the PKM refused to surrender.
keyPoints.bm: Rundingan Baling (28–29 Disember 1955) gagal kerana PKM enggan menyerah diri.

meaning.en: Plan by Lt-Gen Sir Harold Briggs to resettle about half a million squatters into New Villages.
meaning.bm: Rancangan Lt-Jen Sir Harold Briggs untuk menempatkan semula kira-kira setengah juta setinggan ke Kampung Baru.

meaning.en: Guarded settlement with fences and basic facilities, cutting links with the Min Yuen.
meaning.bm: Penempatan berkawal berpagar dengan kemudahan asas, memutuskan hubungan dengan Min Yuen.

meaning.en: White: free of communists, with controls lifted (first: Melaka, 1953). Black: still dangerous, under strict control.
meaning.bm: Putih: bebas komunis, sekatan dilonggarkan (pertama: Melaka, 1953). Hitam: masih berbahaya, di bawah kawalan ketat.

meaning.en: Using propaganda, rewards and services to weaken the enemy and win the people.
meaning.bm: Menggunakan propaganda, ganjaran dan perkhidmatan untuk melemahkan musuh dan memenangi rakyat.

meaning.en: Police unit of Orang Asli who tracked communists in the deep jungle.
meaning.bm: Unit polis Orang Asli yang menjejak komunis di hutan tebal.

meaning.en: Volunteers who guarded their own villages.

points.en: Detention without trial, death penalty for carrying arms, food control and search powers.
points.bm: Tahanan tanpa bicara, hukuman mati kerana memiliki senjata, kawalan makanan dan kuasa menggeledah.

points.en: Police: Special Branch (intelligence), Special Constables (guarding estates and mines), Women Police, Jungle Squads, Senoi Praaq and Auxiliary Police.
points.bm: Polis: Cawangan Khas (risikan), Special Constables (mengawal ladang dan lombong), Polis Wanita, Polis Hutan, Senoi Praaq dan Polis Bantuan.

points.en: Army: the Malay Regiment, Commonwealth forces (e.g. Britain, Australia, New Zealand, Gurkhas) and the Sarawak Rangers (Iban trackers).
points.bm: Tentera: Askar Melayu, tentera Komanwel (cth. Britain, Australia, New Zealand, Gurkha) dan Sarawak Rangers (penjejak Iban).

points.en: Volunteers: the Home Guard.
points.bm: Sukarelawan: Home Guard.

points.en: National registration and identity cards (from 1948) to identify communists and supporters.
points.bm: Pendaftaran kebangsaan dan kad pengenalan (mulai 1948) untuk mengenal pasti komunis dan penyokongnya.

points.en: Briggs Plan: New Villages from 1950.
points.bm: Rancangan Briggs: Kampung Baru mulai 1950.

points.en: Amnesty (pengampunan) offers to communists who surrendered.
points.bm: Tawaran pengampunan kepada komunis yang menyerah diri.

points.en: "People's Month against Bandits" campaign (1950) and curfews.
points.bm: Kempen Bulan Rakyat Melawan Penjahat (1950) dan perintah berkurung.

points.en: Templer's visits to villages; easier citizenship (1952); the Kuala Lumpur municipal election (1952).
points.bm: Lawatan Templer ke kampung; syarat kewarganegaraan dilonggarkan (1952); pilihan raya Majlis Perbandaran Kuala Lumpur (1952).

points.en: Cash rewards for information; winning the Orang Asli's trust; better information services (leaflets, radio, films).
points.bm: Hadiah wang tunai untuk maklumat; memenangi kepercayaan Orang Asli; memajukan perkhidmatan penerangan (risalah, radio, filem).

points.en: Declaring White and Black areas.
points.bm: Memperkenalkan kawasan putih dan kawasan hitam.

points.en: 28–29 December 1955 at Baling, Kedah: Tunku Abdul Rahman, David Marshall (Singapore) and Tan Cheng Lock met Chin Peng.
points.bm: 28–29 Disember 1955 di Baling, Kedah: Tunku Abdul Rahman, David Marshall (Singapura) dan Tan Cheng Lock bertemu Chin Peng.

points.en: Failed: the PKM wanted to be recognised as a legal party and refused to surrender or be investigated.
points.bm: Gagal: PKM mahu diiktiraf sebagai parti yang sah dan enggan menyerah diri atau disiasat.

event.en: Briggs Plan begins; Home Guard formed.
event.bm: Rancangan Briggs bermula; Home Guard ditubuhkan.

question.en: Why was the "hearts and minds" approach more effective than force alone?
question.bm: Mengapakah pendekatan "memenangi hati dan fikiran" lebih berkesan daripada kekerasan semata-mata?

answer.en: Communists depended on support from villagers. By giving security, services, citizenship and rewards, the government won people's loyalty, so they stopped helping the communists and gave information instead.
answer.bm: Komunis bergantung pada sokongan penduduk kampung. Dengan memberi keselamatan, kemudahan, kewarganegaraan dan ganjaran, kerajaan memenangi kesetiaan rakyat, maka mereka berhenti membantu komunis dan memberikan maklumat.

tip.en: A long list! Group the measures under: Undang-undang, Pasukan keselamatan, Kawalan (IC, Briggs, berkurung), Perang saraf, Rundingan.
tip.bm: Senarai yang panjang! Kumpulkan langkah di bawah: Undang-undang, Pasukan keselamatan, Kawalan (IC, Briggs, berkurung), Perang saraf, Rundingan.

keyPoints.en: Political effects: more people became citizens, the MCA was formed (1949) and independence came sooner.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan politik: lebih ramai menjadi warganegara, MCA ditubuhkan (1949) dan kemerdekaan dipercepat.

keyPoints.en: Socio-economic effects: high spending on security, suffering of the people and strained race relations.
keyPoints.bm: Kesan sosioekonomi: perbelanjaan keselamatan yang tinggi, penderitaan rakyat dan hubungan kaum yang renggang.

keyPoints.en: The Emergency was declared over on 31 July 1960.

meaning.en: Malayan Chinese Association, founded 27 February 1949 by Tan Cheng Lock; helped Chinese in New Villages and opposed communism.
meaning.bm: Persatuan Cina Malaya, ditubuhkan 27 Februari 1949 oleh Tan Cheng Lock; membantu orang Cina di Kampung Baru dan menentang komunis.

points.en: Citizenship rules were eased (1952) so more Chinese and Indians became citizens and loyal to Malaya.
points.bm: Syarat kewarganegaraan dilonggarkan (1952) supaya lebih ramai orang Cina dan India menjadi warganegara dan setia kepada Tanah Melayu.

points.en: MCA was formed and later joined UMNO in the Alliance.
points.bm: MCA ditubuhkan dan kemudian bergabung dengan UMNO dalam Perikatan.

points.en: Britain sped up self-government so that a local government could fight communism with the people's support.
points.bm: British mempercepat pemerintahan sendiri supaya kerajaan tempatan dapat menentang komunis dengan sokongan rakyat.

points.en: Huge spending on security instead of development.
points.bm: Perbelanjaan besar untuk keselamatan, bukan pembangunan.

points.en: Suffering: deaths, curfews, food control and resettlement.
points.bm: Penderitaan: kematian, perintah berkurung, kawalan makanan dan penempatan semula.

points.en: Race relations were strained because most communists were Chinese and most security forces were Malays.
points.bm: Hubungan kaum renggang kerana kebanyakan komunis orang Cina dan kebanyakan pasukan keselamatan orang Melayu.

points.en: By the late 1950s most areas were "white"; the Emergency ended on 31 July 1960.
points.bm: Menjelang akhir 1950-an kebanyakan kawasan menjadi "putih"; Darurat tamat pada 31 Julai 1960.

points.en: The PKM finally signed a peace agreement with Malaysia and Thailand at Hatyai on 2 December 1989.
points.bm: PKM akhirnya menandatangani perjanjian damai dengan Malaysia dan Thailand di Hatyai pada 2 Disember 1989.

question.en: How did the Emergency help speed up independence?

answer.en: Britain realised that communism could only be defeated with local support, so it handed more power to local leaders — elections, the Member System and finally independence in 1957.
answer.bm: British sedar komunis hanya boleh dikalahkan dengan sokongan rakyat tempatan, maka ia menyerahkan lebih banyak kuasa kepada pemimpin tempatan — pilihan raya, Sistem Ahli dan akhirnya kemerdekaan pada 1957.
